text:
SpaceX's payments to Brownsville fund a wastewater reclamation plant (about 8 million gallons a day) and a water plant expansion (about 10 million more). The city uses about 21 million gallons a day, 70% from the Rio Grande. The mayor says the deal could reduce or even end that reliance.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fp4NCLi_k-I

Source: Texas Tribune via KRGV, Aug 31, 2026. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
